item.title: Walters Art Museum appoints new chief curator
item.description: The Walters Art Museum has appointed Dr. Katherine Larson as its new Chief Collections and Curatorial Affairs Officer and Senior Curator of Ancient Art.

item.title: Explore American Craft Made Baltimore, the largest juried craft fair on the East Coast.
item.description: Now in its 49th year, American Craft Made Baltimore brings together 400 artists, 10,000 attendees, and dozens of local partner organizations from across the East Coast for shopping, demonstrations, hands-on experiences, and connection through craft. February 20-22, 2026 at the Baltimore Convention Center. Single-day tickets and weekend passes are available now!

item.title: Grilled Cheese and Panini Shop ‘Toasty Corner’ Coming to Federal Hill
item.description: Grilled cheese and panini shop Toasty Corner is opening at the former Afters Cafe space at 1001 S. Charles St. in Federal Hill.

item.title: Odorite building sells for $1M to Astoria Charm Property Management Inc.
item.description: Astoria Charm Property Management Inc. on Tuesday completed its acquisition of the former Odorite building at 1111 Maryland Ave.

item.title: Another notable MICA grad comes to BMA: Louis Fratino paired with Henri Matisse
item.description: Another celebrated MICA graduate will grace the BMA. Louis Fratino's art will be paired with Matisse for this exhibition opening in March.

item.title: Jail Call Debated in Homicide Trial
item.description: The jury trial of a 41-year-old man accused of homicide, robbery and firearm charges concluded after closing arguments on Feb. 2.

item.title: Congressional Black Caucus and Zelle announce scholarship for Morgan State University students
item.description: The Congressional Black Caucus and Zelle are offering scholarships to students at Morgan interested in small business ownership.
